summary: Create an app in the Shopify Dev Dashboard and release a version to get OAuth credentials; testing on your own store is quick. Distributing to other merchants (even unlisted) is reported to require Shopify review.

difficulty.label: Review required
difficulty.rationale: Dev-store testing is self-serve, but a Shopify staff member says an unlisted public app still needs review and a $19 registration fee.

effort.basis: Our estimate for Dev Dashboard setup. Composio's guide shows only a 3-minute reading time.

wait.statement: No review duration found. A Shopify staff reply on the developer community says an unlisted public app 'will still need to be reviewed'.

composio_managed.note: Not checked against the Composio API yet.

requirements.text: A Shopify store (development store works for testing) and access to the Dev Dashboard.
The Composio connect step asks for the store subdomain (the part before .myshopify.com).
Distribution method is a one-way choice: 'You can't change the method after you select it.' Decide public vs custom before you build.
Custom distribution: you generate an install link for a specific store and send it to the store owner.
A custom app can be installed on multiple stores only when they belong to the same Plus organization.
Public distribution: you submit for Shopify's review when the app is ready.
App Store checklist: authorize with OAuth immediately on install, and use session tokens rather than third-party cookies or local storage.

scopes_and_access.text: Composio's example scopes: read/write orders and products, optionally customers and inventory.

gotchas.text: You must click Release on a version in the Dev Dashboard to finalize the app configuration.
The redirect URL must match exactly.
The Composio guide does not say what to use for the App URL.

steps.title: Open the Dev Dashboard
steps.detail: Shopify admin > search 'App Development' > Build apps in Dev Dashboard.

steps.title: Create the app and first version
steps.detail: Name, App URL, scopes, redirect URL from your Composio auth config; click Release.

steps.title: Copy client ID and secret
steps.why_not_agent: Secret goes to your secret store.

steps.title: Create the Composio auth config and connect
steps.detail: Own credentials; connect with external user ID and store subdomain; install the app and grant permissions.

steps.title: To serve other merchants: plan for Shopify review
steps.detail: Ask Shopify (Partner support / dev community) which distribution type fits and what review applies.
steps.why_not_agent: Needs your Partner account and Shopify's response.

blockers.symptom: Other merchants cannot install your app
blockers.likely_cause: Not yet approved for the distribution you chose.
blockers.fix: Check distribution type and review status in your Partner/Dev Dashboard.
blockers.escalate_when: Review status is unclear after submission.

review_process.text: A Shopify staff member on the community forum said an unlisted public app still needs review and the $19 registration fee, and must meet all review criteria. This is a forum post, not official documentation.

next_actions: Build and test on a development store.
Before launch, confirm distribution and review rules with Shopify's official docs.

agent_can: Draft the review-readiness checklist once official criteria are fetched.
you_must: Operate the Dev Dashboard and handle Shopify review.

uncertainties: Shopify's distribution page does not say whether custom distribution needs review.
No official page we read states how long App Store review takes or any registration fee; the $19 figure is from a community reply and may have changed.
The checklist page did not mention GDPR/compliance webhooks; Shopify's separate docs on them were not read.
Composio's Shopify guide path was followed, not tested.
